notes: Step 4 v9 (RES-23, the familiarity mark; ADR-008 amendment 2026-09-17, declared before this run): v6's recipe with one variable, journal_familiarity_mark: every read window line carries the organ's own similarity between the query's cue and that line's episode cue, `A(0.97):<payload>`, in training and at evaluation, so the model can decide on the organ's evidence instead of a comparison it cannot compose at 27M (rows 28, 29). The mark is always the organ's computation, whatever route put the line in the window. The mark oracle (no model) is the declared ceiling. Everything else as v6: the same parent N1, 120M tokens, the paired negatives with their shape, the same seed.
